Mr. N.R. Patil, A.G.P. for the Respondent Nos. 3 & 4/S  CORAM: AVINASH G. GHAROTE, J.
DATED : 10th FEBRUARY, 2023 Heard Mr. Pande, learned counsel for the appellants.
2. The Land Acquisition Officer by the Award dated 21.08.2017 (page 57) has granted compensation of Rs. 31,92,600/- per hectare for the land of Survey No. 141 Mouza Ruikhairi admeasuring 3480 sq.mts.

When the matter went before the Arbitrator under Section 3-G (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 by the appellants, the Arbitrator has enhanced the compensation to Rs. 3330/- per sq.mtr., vide order dated 31.07.2019, considering that the land was highway adjacent by applying the ready reckoner rate (page 132).
In application under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, the order dated 31.07.2019 has been set aside, hence this appeal.
Issue notice to the respondents for final disposal of the matter at the admission stage, returnable Ms. Alka Nilesh Agrawal And Others vs National Highway Auth.
